lede: Rutgers carries a full EdgeDesk team rating at +0.9; Howard is not one of the 138 FBS programmes EdgeDesk rates, so the comparison is one-sided by construction rather than by judgement.
EdgeDesk makes it Rutgers -26.3 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Rutgers winning 96% of simulations.

The roster and position-group comparison below explains where EdgeDesk’s separation comes from on the side it can measure; Howard is absent from the FBS player dataset, so the exact size of that gap is not established.
Data confidence on this matchup is 55% — enough to publish, not enough to treat the exact margin as settled.

favourite.heading: Why Rutgers can pull away
bullets: Rutgers is the better football team by 20.8 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 64% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (+20.8 pts).
Playing at Rutgers is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).
Stylistically the matchup favours Rutgers by 1.5 points: ball control vs front disruption (+1.5 pts).

underdog.heading: Why Howard can keep it close
bullets: The outcome range is 15.1 points wide at one sigma — p10 +3.3 to p90 +47.3 for Rutgers, so a projection of +26.3 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 3%.
60% of the model’s own input contract was empty for this game — no roster, starter, injury or per-player talent context reached it, so the number leans on team strength more than it should.
Howard is not in the FBS rating set, so EdgeDesk cannot measure what it does well. An unmeasured opponent is an unknown, not a weak one, and the size of the gap is not established.

label.means: Reliability is 57 (LOW), THIN DATA, under the 60 bar below which EdgeDesk argues against its own number. Why: the projected spread moves ±7.94 pts (1 SD) across 64 perturbation scenarios (largest source: away team rating, ±8 pts); Howard is priced from the shared FCS floor rating — one number for every FCS programme, not a rating of this team; the stylistic pairing needs a measured profile for BOTH sides and Howard is outside the FBS field the profiles cover. A large gap on low reliability is more suspicious, not less.
